contract:
Contract ListBookHistory::listOverDueBook(uid: String): Set(BookCopy) {
	definition:
		existingUser: User = User.allInstances()->any(u: User|u.UserID = uid),
		overdueActiveLoans: Set(Loan) = existingUser.LoanedBook->select(l: Loan|l.IsReturned = false and
		l.OverDueFee>0.0)
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->exists(u: User|u.UserID = uid) and
		overdueActiveLoans.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		result = overdueActiveLoans->projectSet(l: Loan|l.LoanedCopy)
}
